_comment: How banks of heavy fog come over an Age (Jonah, 2026-10-12): `often` is how much of the time a bank
lies over it, and `thickness` how close one closes in.
Strange throughout: it is only ever seen, and nothing in it can hurt you. Any step brings a whole fog,
rolling in about a quarter of the time and closing the view to a couple of dozen blocks; the dials only
make it more often and closer. Leans a little wet.
